```yaml
name: Build Linux no-container

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      wheel_path:
        description: Path to the built wheel
        value: ${{ steps.set_wheel_path.outputs.wheel_path }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: "3.10"

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Build wheels
      uses: ./.github/actions/build-and-upload
      with:
        setup-cuda: v1.3.0
        python-preference: only-managed
        platform: ${{ inputs.platform }}

    - name: Determine wheel path
      id: set_wheel_path
      run: |
        wheel=$(find dist -name "*.whl" | head -n 1)
        echo "wheel_path=$wheel" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    - name: Upload wheel artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: wheel-${{ inputs.platform }}
        path: ${{ steps.set_wheel_path.outputs.wheel_path }}

    - name: Post-build cleanup
      if: runner.os == 'Linux' && runner.name == 'self-hosted'
      run: |
        echo "Cleaning up build artifacts..."
        rm -rf flash-attention
        rm -rf venv
        rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
        rm -rf ~/.cache/uv
        rm -rf /usr/local/cuda
```
